successful_execution_receipts.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='parsing/html/reader.go'
s=open(p).read()
# 1. tokenText: don't skip whitespace-only raw text
old='''		case tokenText:
			if strings.TrimSpace(tok.text) == "" {
				continue
			}'''
new='''		case tokenText:
			if !tok.raw && strings.TrimSpace(tok.text) == "" {
				continue
			}'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
# 2. toElementModel
old='''func (n *htmlNode) toElementModel() (*model.Value, error) {
	text := strings.TrimSpace(n.Text)'''
new='''func (n *htmlNode) toElementModel() (*model.Value, error) {
	text := n.Text
	if !n.raw {
		text = strings.TrimSpace(text)
	}'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
# 3. toStructuredModel
old='''	if err := res.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue(strings.TrimSpace(n.Text))); err != nil {'''
new='''	text := n.Text
	if !n.raw {
		text = strings.TrimSpace(text)
	}
	if err := res.SetMapKey("text", model.NewStringValue(text)); err != nil {'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w parsing/html/reader.go && go build ./... && go test ./parsing/html/ 2>&1 | tail -5
cd /app && go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "no test files" | tail -25
